decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has kept its own dedicated page for two years, which signals a growing commitment and positive resolution of uncertainty, so the option should be exercised further rather than abandoned.

The hyaluronic serum is still listed after two years, costs little to keep for a small cosmetics maker, and sits in a popular category, so keeping the option open is cheap even though it has not been promoted further.
The cleansing oil launched only in 2024 and likely replaces the dropped cleansing milk, so its prospects are still uncertain and keeping it on the market costs little.
